{{Quote|Today we have fourteen different worlds applying for membership in the Galactic Alliance.|[[Wynn Dorvan]], to his [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|own office]]|<ref name="FJ">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
'''Aloxor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="FJ" /> located in the [[Esaga sector/Legends|Esaga sector]] within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[44 ABY]], a wave of revolutions swept across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], bringing an end to [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] on numerous worlds. The newly established governments submitted many applications to the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] from worlds that had previously been denied membership. Although such applications were largely the Senate's purview, [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Wynn Dorvan]] still had to be involved. [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|His office]] convened emergency meetings to consider applications from fourteen different worlds seeking [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] membership. The planet Aloxor could also have been among those under consideration, but it had fallen short of the fourteenth position by eighteen and a half [[standard second]]s.<ref name="FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Aloxor was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'', which was written by [[Christie Golden]]<ref name="FJ" /> and released in [[2011]].<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=book/68770/star-wars-fate-of-the-jedi-ascension-by-christie-golden|text=Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi: Ascension}}</ref> Later, the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online appendix]] to the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Aloxor system/Legends|Aloxor star system]] and the planet itself in grid square R-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
